$comment: Launcher manifest for the bag-capacity mod (plan: 'Data model'). This file only DESCRIBES the mod; the value store stays the live %LOCALAPPDATA%\LeafItAloneSafe\bag-capacity.json that apply.ps1 already seeds and reads, and apply/revert still run the validated scripts. Adding a mod means writing a manifest like this, never new launcher UI code.
name: Bigger leaf bags
description: Makes every leaf bag bigger so you can carry more before unloading. Choose a simple multiplier over the vanilla capacities, or set each bag size explicitly.

fields.label: Sizing mode
fields.help: multiplier scales the vanilla 50/200/500/800; sizes sets each bag explicitly.

fields.label: Multiplier
fields.help: Applied to the vanilla capacities (small 50, medium 200, big 500, giant 800).
